name: BuiltWith
summary: Website technology profiling: the tech stack and metadata of a domain, sites using a technology, related sites and domains for a company name.

api_key.description: A BuiltWith API key (builtwith.com > API). Sent as 'Authorization: API <key>'; the KEY query parameter also works but leaks into logs.

notes: Credits: 1 per domain on Domain, Relationships (per domain across its pages for 10 minutes), Company to URL, Keywords, Redirects and Trust; Free, Trends, WhoAmI and Usage cost nothing. Lists needs a subscription. X-API-CREDITS-* response headers show the balance.
Rate limit: 8 concurrent requests and 10 per second; over it returns 429.
Paths carry the format: these entries use api.json. Well-formed errors come back in an Errors array; treat any non-200 as an error too.
Technology names use dashes for spaces (AB-Tasty). Check a name for free with the Trends API before spending credits on Lists.

endpoints.name: Get a domain's technologies
endpoints.summary: Technologies on a domain (current and historic, with first and last detected dates), spend history, and company metadata.

HIDETEXT.description: yes: drop description, link, tag and category fields.

HIDEDL.description: yes: drop description and link fields.

NOMETA.description: yes: no company metadata (address, names); faster.

NOPII.description: yes: remove people names and emails.

TRUST.description: yes: add Trust data, one more credit.

endpoints.name: Get a domain's technology summary
endpoints.summary: Free: counts and update ranges per technology group for a domain, without the technology names.

endpoints.name: List sites using a technology
endpoints.summary: Sites using a technology, filterable by country, co-used technologies, spend, revenue, employees and traffic rank.

TECH.description: Technology name with dashes for spaces.

OTHERTECHS.description: Comma-separated technologies the sites must also use, up to 16.

META.description: yes: include names, titles, socials, addresses, emails, phones and ranks.

COUNTRY.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (UK for the United Kingdom), comma-separated.

OFFSET.description: The NextOffset value from the previous page; END means done.

SINCE.description: Live since a date or phrase such as '30 Days Ago'.

ALL.description: yes: include historical sites; not with SINCE.

SPEND.description: Monthly tech spend filter as number|operator (EQ, LT, LTE, GT, GTE), e.g. 100|GT.

notes: Needs a Lists subscription. Page with OFFSET=NextOffset until it is END.

endpoints.name: Find related sites
endpoints.summary: Domains sharing identifiers with a domain (analytics and tag ids, hosting, ownership signals).

PAGE.description: Page, from 1; follow next_page while more_results is true (up to 1000 matches a page).

notes: Keep LOOKUP and IP unchanged while paging. 1 credit per domain across all pages while the 10-minute cache holds.

endpoints.name: Find a company's domains
endpoints.summary: Domains for a company name, with spend, country and social links.

endpoints.name: Get a technology's metadata
endpoints.summary: Free: a technology's canonical name, tag, categories, description and trends link; also validates a TECH name (error code -8 when unknown).

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credits used, purchased and remaining; free.
